correctness.rationale: The Hermitian spectral projection is rational since eigenvalues are constant under pointwise unitary similarity. For each extreme point, a positive-semidefinite singular rational matrix has a nonzero polynomial null vector by rational Gaussian elimination and clearing denominators; this forces the exact Hardy numerical expectation. Minkowski convex hull and Toeplitz–Hausdorff give equality. The smooth counterexample has no Hardy analytic eigen-section because exp(-1/z) has an essential pole, but localized kernels approximate its endpoints.
